verificationMethod: HTTP GET from the dev machine against each documented endpoint; status codes recorded below.

sources.name: NDMA SACHET — National Disaster Alert Portal
sources.license: Government of India, NDMA — public alert dissemination
sources.cacheStrategy: ETag conditional GET; retain CAP identifier + sent/effective/expires/sender per alert

sources.name: India Meteorological Department — CAP alerts
sources.recommendedUse: PRIMARY weather warnings (cyclone, heavy rainfall, thunderstorm)
sources.cacheStrategy: ETag conditional GET; 15 min freshness window
sources.caveat: Polygons present only when the CAP alert itself carries one. Never synthesise.

sources.name: USGS Earthquake Hazards Program
sources.recommendedUse: Earthquake point observations. NOT a hazard polygon. NOT an evacuation zone.
sources.caveat: Epicentre is a point observation. Magnitude alone does not yield a danger radius.

sources.name: NASA FIRMS — active fire detections

endpoints.name: area/csv
endpoints.verified: HTTP 200 — returned live VIIRS_SNPP_NRT rows for the India bbox

sources.recommendedUse: Point hotspot detections. NOT a fire perimeter. NOT a burn scar. NOT verified ground fire.
sources.caveat: Each row is one satellite overpass pixel. Must be labelled 'satellite-detected hotspot'.

sources.name: Open-Meteo

endpoints.name: forecast
endpoints.verified: HTTP 200 — returned current + hourly for an India coordinate

sources.recommendedUse: Weather context only. NOT an official disaster warning and NOT a warning authority.

sources.name: Census of India 2011
sources.license: Census of India — open access with attribution
sources.caveat: 2011 data. Must never be presented as current population or current evacuation demand.

sources.name: National Wide Information Centre administrative boundaries
sources.license: UNVERIFIED — confirm redistribution terms before shipping in an APK
sources.caveat: Redistribution terms not yet confirmed. Do not bundle into an APK until checked.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap
sources.caveat: OSM has no India-wide authoritative 'evacuation shelter' tag coverage. School/hospital/community-hall POIs are NOT shelters.

sources.name: EM-DAT — Emergency Events Database
sources.caveat: Archive of past events. Must never render as a current hazard.

sources.name: NDEM / NRSC National Database for Emergency Management
sources.handlingRule: Do not scrape. Report as unavailable. No silent third-party substitution.

sources.name: NRSC Bhuvan thematic dashboard
sources.handlingRule: Manual acquisition only; register layer + date + license before use.

sources.name: Central Water Commission — hydrology / flood forecasting
sources.handlingRule: No open live gauge feed found. River level must stay UNKNOWN, never estimated.

sources.name: Survey of India — Online Maps
sources.handlingRule: Reference basemap only. No redistribution assumed.

sources.name: INCOIS — Indian Tsunami Early Warning Centre
sources.handlingRule: Bulletin portal; no open bulk feed found. Do not infer tsunami risk from this app.
